mission.title: Open Mars Exploration
mission.objective: Build a livable Mars base before rover or habitat failure.
alerts: Explore until battery or livability fails

rules.label: Colony O2 reserve
rules.description: Base life-support oxygen belongs to the colony system, not the unmanned rover.

rules.label: Colony water reserve
rules.description: Water is stored and processed by base systems for habitat readiness.

rules.label: Battery survival
rules.description: The rover can no longer operate when stored power is exhausted.

rules.label: Rover health
rules.description: Dust, low power, terrain hazards, and system stress damage the active rover.

rules.label: Habitat livability
rules.description: Open exploration continues until rover battery, rover health, or habitat livability fails.

rules.label: Rover payload
rules.description: Scan and Extract require free payload capacity. Return to the build pad and use Unload when full.

rules.label: Build pad service
rules.description: Service is needed when dust, damaged infrastructure, or poor power margin threatens the build pad.
